title: Experiment Variation: Varying Prompt Engineering Strategies for Vulnerability Detection

original_idea.body:
# Experiment Variation: Varying Prompt Engineering Strategies for Vulnerability Detection

**Problem:** AI vulnerability detection performance varies with prompting strategy, but no systematic comparison exists across security-relevant prompting techniques.

**Direction:** Run a factorial experiment: 5 prompt strategies (zero-shot, chain-of-thought, few-shot, role-playing as security auditor, adversarial prompt) × 3 LLMs × 20 CVEs. Measure detection rate, false positive rate, explanation quality. Report which prompt strategy maximizes defense-relevant metrics.

**Why it matters:** Even without model changes, better prompting could significantly improve AI-assisted defense. This is immediately actionable for practitioners.

**Relevant context:** Zero-shot accuracy 37.4% → 57-62% with security instructions and few-shot (MDPI 2025). Systematic prompt strategy comparison for vulnerability detection not published.
